long_biography.plain_text:
Victoria Court began with a 38-room property in Pasig that Archimedes “Archie” Rosario King turned into a new premium drive-in hotel format. After entering the family lodging business in 1980, he took charge of one management group, introduced themed suites and expanded the brand across Metro Manila. He also brought Best Western affiliation to Hotel La Corona and developed properties beyond the capital.

King inherited a platform created by his father, Anito Lodge founder Angelo King, but built a distinct hospitality identity around service, privacy and design. He later divided the group between his sons while remaining its senior steward. Away from hotels, he funded livelihood centres and classrooms and became a founding trustee of Gawad Kalinga's Enchanted Farm. He died in a helicopter crash in Batangas in 2015, aged 62.
